args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## PRODUCT COMPLIANCE & BOM VALIDATION ⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1** - ⭐ EXACT FIT: Validates BOM against regulatory & engineering standards; flags non-compliant materials; recommends approved substitutes; generates compliance docs

## EQUIPMENT MODIFICATION & SERVICE VALIDATION ⭐ NEW
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - ⭐ EQUIPMENT VALIDATION FOR PRODUCTION READINESS: Assesses affected IT equipment & digital twin configs during engineering changes; routes service tickets by criticality; ensures infrastructure alignment & identifies maintenance/integration work requirements

## PROCUREMENT - PURCHASE ORDER MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1** - ⭐ DIRECT PO EXECUTION: REST API for creating, updating, monitoring POs

## PROCUREMENT - SOURCING CAMPAIGN & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1** - ⭐ VENDOR & CAMPAIGN INFO CONSOLIDATION: Retrieves sourcing campaigns, customer accounts, and vendor relationship information; manages account hierarchies for compliance and readiness approvals

## PROCUREMENT - WORKFORCE COST CORRELATION ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:ProcurementWorkforceCompensationAPI:v1** - ⭐ BEST FIT FOR WORKFORCE-PROCUREMENT COST ANALYSIS: Integrates employee compensation, payroll, workforce assignments with procurement workflows; enables correlation of labor allocation with sourcing/purchasing activities

## PROCUREMENT & MATERIAL IMPACT FOR PRODUCT TRANSITIONS
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - ⭐ CORE for product transition procurement impact

## SALES OPPORTUNITY QUALIFICATION & PRIORITIZATION ⭐ NEW
- **sap.crm:agent:OpportunityQualificationAdvisor:v1** - ⭐ PERFECT FIT FOR SALES OPPORTUNITY QUALIFICATION: Autonomously evaluates sales opportunities against qualification criteria; recommends actions; prioritizes high-value prospects; ensures consistent lead scoring across sales org

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & SALES COORDINATION
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesProductChangeCoordinator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; automates notification; coordinates sales strategy adjustments
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; triggers coordinated customer engagement

## ANALYTICS & REPORTING FOR SERVICE TO PRODUCTION
- **corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Generates diagnostic reports, analyzes incident patterns

## SALES COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesCompensationOrchestrator:v1** - Sales-specific compensation

## SERVICE REQUEST & ORDER CAPTURE
- **sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine** - Converts sales opportunities to customer orders

## PRODUCTION QUALITY & YIELD ANALYSIS ⭐
- **my.mes:apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1** - ⭐ PRODUCTION QUALITY & YIELD: REST API for OEE data (availability, performance, quality rates); historical trend analysis; predictive insights
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1** - Real-time quality monitoring; detects deviations; monitors QualityInspection and ProductionOrder outcomes

## WORKFORCE COMPENSATION & LABOR ALLOCATION ⭐
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - ⭐ ENGINEERING LABOR ALLOCATION & COMPENSATION ADJUSTMENTS: Monitors employee competencies and engineering change requests; coordinates optimal resource allocation
- **sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1** - Automates compensation policy enforcement and processes salary adjustments
- **sap.sf:agent:PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator:v1** - Orchestrates performance review cycles
